pool.note: Sum of memory caps of every tx2-* reservation plus running tx2-* containers outside the ledger (research probes) plus the new one must stay <= memLimitBytes (11 GiB of 12). VM disk used plus every active reservation's disk forecast plus the new one must stay <= diskUsedLimitBytes (50 GiB of the 60 GiB VM disk, PLAN section 7).

xtdb.diskForecastNote: Start conservative: XTDB pre-GC growth about 5.5x was seen on the homebase (PLAN section 7). dev holds many small test scopes; s* hold scale runs. Scale experiments refine these.

small.note: EXP-X05 follower sized to the 4.5 GiB the pool leaves beside both dev residents (orchestrator slot plan 2026-11-07): writer 3.5 + follower 1.0 GiB. Below R19 E9's 1.5-1.75 GiB, so results on it are provisional.

follower.note: EXP-X05 read-only follower tx2-xtdb-<slot>-ro on the slot's volume, admitted against the pool like any reservation, held under the slot's lock. 1.75 GiB is R19 1.6/E9's smallest sane read node. volumeMode ro mounts the volume read-only at the kernel as a second barrier behind readOnlyDatabases. Port is the slot port + portOffset.

qlever.diskForecastNote: Start conservative: a QLever rebuild keeps previous.* index files next to the new ones (about 2x index bytes) plus delta growth during the rebuild (PLAN section 7).

dev.note: Raised from 2.5 GiB / 1500M on 2026-11-08: OOM-killed three times (20:57Z, 22:02Z and earlier) under several agents' shared load while its persisted delta grew; recreated with --fresh to drop the delta.
